@syntax If condition Then statement
@syntax If condition Then statement Else statement
@syntax If condition
@syntax     statements
@syntax ElseIf condition
@syntax     statements
@syntax Else
@syntax     statements
@syntax EndIf
Runs statements only when the condition is true, which means it is not 0. The one-line form runs the statements after `Then` up to the end of the line. The block form has no `Then`, may have any number of `ElseIf` parts and one `Else`, and ends with `EndIf` or `End If`.

Comparisons give 1 for true and 0 for false, and `And`, `Or` and `Not` combine them.

```blitzbasic
;run
x = 5
If x > 3 Then Print "big" Else Print "small"

If x < 3
	Print "less than 3"
ElseIf x < 10 And x <> 7
	Print "3 to 9"
Else
	Print "10 or more"
EndIf
```

```text
big
3 to 9
```
